ThingDef.label: neutrosynthesizer
ThingDef.description: An archotech android kidney built around a miniaturized infinite chemreactor. Unlike standard neutrofilters that merely recycle spent neutroamine, this organ actively synthesizes fresh neutroamine from raw chemical feedstock, restoring lost neutroamine at a rate far exceeding the base neutro synthesis subroutine.\n\nInstalling two neutrosynthesizers allows an android to recover from neutro loss faster than a human recovers from blood loss.
